entities.summary: Piotr Nowakowski is a Polish professional volleyball player who plays as a middle blocker for Trefl Gdańsk. He is a former member of the Poland national team, a participant in 3 Olympic Games, two–time World Champion, 2009 European Champion, and the 2012 World League winner.
